caveats: Seed 42 has a different reported learning rate; not a seed-only replicate
Small fixed noise bank is a pilot, not independent model replication
Magnitude/power omits phase; grayscale omits color
PNG preprocessing clips and quantizes; raw differences reported separately
Mantel agreement is not image identity or proof of memorization/generalization
No confidence intervals or formal test of differences between correlations
Window/method sensitivity reruns create additional tests beyond this run's Holm family
mantel: Joint image-label permutations, two-sided, +1 p correction; Holm over all valid comparisons
representation: RGB PNG /255; luminance .299R+.587G+.114B; subtract mean; optional Hann; 2D FFT norm=ortho; zero DC; log1p(abs(FFT)**2); flatten; Euclidean distances
